programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: When Fang returns from the U.S. to see Rose but starts eyeing her old friend's fiance, Rose shows that she has a thorny side.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: Bandits disturb the peace until a martial artist and his student, son and servant go to avenge his murdered wife and set things right.

programme.title: Return of the Dead
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang's dark offering depicts the destructive effects of lust as narrated by three psychiatric patients in an asylum.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: A village boy recruits his friends to help peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: The Kid With the Golden Arm
programme.desc: Director Chang Cheh reunites the Five Venoms in his second biggest cult hit in the West, featuring Lo Meng's most memorable performance.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: What starts off as a musical romp turns into something more akin to a Shakespearean tragedy than a beach-babe party. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: The story of the Shaolin Temple's betrayal by the White-Browed Hermit and Shaolin hothead Fong Sai-yuk's revenge bid gets retold again.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: In Shaw Brothers' showcase for the talented Ling Yun, a young drummer hungry for fame sacrifices everything including love, for his art. Will the prize prove worth the cost?

programme.title: The Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: After enduring several trials (including his girlfriend's rape), a man (Chen Wo-Fu) puts his tai chi skills to deadly use.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: Seven seductive Spiders lie in wait for our faithful heroes in the third installment of the Shaw Brothers adaptation of Journey to the West.

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: Starring John Chiang, Ti Lung, Yueh Wah, Ku Feng and Chen Kuan Tai, this classic depicts how the brothers of the classic Water Margin fight local authorities.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Directed by Chang Cheh and starring Ti Lung in his first main role, this drama depicts how two lovers contend with family opposition and an unjust accusation.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: This Yuan Dynasty tale tells of the Sacred Fire sect, Wu Tang clan, O Mei's disciples, a sacred book, and the destruction of Shaolin.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: After a bride-to-be is discovered to be possessed, justice must be done and an exorcism performed before anyone can rest in peace.

programme.title: Portrait in Crystal
programme.desc: Action - Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader 'Yama' to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan and Pai Pan to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang directs this fascinating comedy about three couples and forbidden love across Macau and Hong Kong.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: Screen legend Alexander Fu plays a son who constantly challenges his father's patience and kung-fu skills until they are forced to fight together.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: After a guilty Alex confesses his affair to Tung, his injured wife, she somehow ends up living with Alex's mother and his mistress under the same roof!

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: When evil ninjas brutally slaughter students from a noble Chinese kung-fu academy, the one survivor forms a powerful group to avenge his fallen comrades.

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Essie Lin Chia plays an evil lady warrior who raises the son of a swordsman who scorned her with a blood-curdling ulterior motive in mind.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Following the lives of three downtrodden, but resilient outcasts, John Lo Mar's gritty social drama paints a sense of realism rarely seen in Hong Kong movies.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master martial arts moviemaker Liu Chia-liang presents this brilliant kung fu comedy, incorporating, some of the best-executed fight sequences ever caught on film.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: This classic romance stars Linda Lin and Kwan Shan| capturing a touching love story between a famous nightclub singer and a young architect.

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien, in the roles of criminal and cop.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays a beauty tricked into sacrificing herself for the good of the Chinese people. However, the truth is revealed too late.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Wei Hung plays the Swordsman At Large, in this deceitful tale of bandits, beauties and blade masters who battle for glory.

programme.title: Inside the Forbidden City
programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers' quintessential 'Huangmei Opera' costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Starring the incomparable Ti Lung and Alexander Fu, this saga captures how a swordsman and a thief joins forces to defeat an assassin sent by the evil Kuo.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: After a young mother and her husband die, one child is sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: It's Meng Yuan-wen versus Kuan Feng in this wild and wacky wushu saga about a priceless pole with a spectacular secret.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: The dedicated wife of a man being pressured by a nasty belly dancer uncovers a pit of deceit, double-crosses, murder and blackmail.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: This heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers tells the tale of a beautiful shepherdess, whose own problems drag her into a love triangle.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Playfulness abounds and innocence is lost in this tale of two naughty females who grow up and discover boys together.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: When deadbeats Ming and Liang stumble upon records of scandals involving government officials, what follows is a humorous misadventure of epic proportions.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: A dying crime lord sends a gang of assassins to steal a special herb that may cure him. However, they become the targets of a couple on a vendetta.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: A chauffeur's daughter and the heir to a cruise ship conglomerate fall in love as they try to outwit greedy relatives who have sights on the company.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: When Ko Chien, a downtrodden kung fu student seeks to save the life of a kung fu master and learn new skills, fate labels him a traitor instead.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: The Monk, Monkey, Friar Sand and Pig find themselves in a realm where women can only give birth to women unless loved by a man.

programme.title: That Man in Chang-an
programme.desc: Yan Jun stars in this romantic Han dynasty adventure epic as a dying emperor alongside an evil queen, amidst plots and counterplots galore!

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: This epic classic charts a romance between two teenage cousins, who pursue their relationship despite objections from their respective families.

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: A singer is blackmailed into committing a heist but when he finds his first love working in the store which he's supposed to rob.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Adapted from the novel Water Margin and starring Ti Lung, this award-winning drama depicts how the courageous Wu Song defeats a tiger, and his bond with Wu Da Lang.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: In director Kuei Chih Hung and kung-fu champion Chen Kuan Tai's best martial arts movie, Chen illuminates the screen as an obsessive chief constable.

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Sek Kin takes a refreshing break from his usual villain's role, playing a friendly ghost who befriends a young boy and helps him reunite his separated parents.

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Based on Gu Long's novel, this drama depicts how the martial artist Shen Lang, unites with his comrades to take down the notorious thug Huan His Wang.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: 3 beautiful salesgirls masquerade as high society belles in a bid to realize their dreams of marrying millionaires.

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: Founded by rogue martial artists, the Qisha gang's specialty is crime. When spies infiltrate the group, they become caught in a power struggle between the gang leader and his righthand man.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho stars in this movie as a revenge seeking gun-for-hire who always gets her man in more ways than one!

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: This is the first of four related Shaw Brothers film adaptations of the legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: A master swordsman takes on a dangerous mission to guard a treasure chest on its way to Xi An. However, he stumbles upon a conspiracy

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: A nightclub owner (Peter Chen Ho) has his way with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Also starring Lily Ho, Chin Ping.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: Shu Pei-pei shines in this production alongside hero Yueh Hua, her stalwart companion, in a battle to rid their town of killers and thieves.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, this drama depicts the legendary beauty Diao Chan, and how she used her charms to help her godfather eradicate corrupt court officials.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A jewel thief tries to have a new life as a singer but a series of robberies gets people wondering if he has returned to his old ways.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu gets out of jail, he gets involved again with his crooked Uncle Chou and caught in other rackets and silly situations.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: Superstars Ti Lung and David Keung team up for in this 71' classic about a young man who is exiled after his godfather's death, but returns with a vengeance.

programme.title: Sons of Good Earth
programme.desc: This multiple award-winning film is King Hu's first solo production, a tale of the Sino-Japanese War that ends in artistic and emotional triumph.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: A righteous man who can't fight and an unjustly wronged swordsman team up to battle against evil.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei stars as Hsiao-Yun, a young singer struggling to juggle her career and her relationship with her pianist lover.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: As Wong Hei, a slick assassin, zeroes in on a millionaire named Shek, little does he expect to find himself the target of someone even more dangerous.

programme.title: Sweet and Wild
programme.desc: With a twisted plot, mistaken identities, along with some terrific musical numbers, this comedy of errors featuring Li Ching is absolutely fabulous.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: In this classic, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu take on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh, making this a 4-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. Now, they must win this deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: A love rectangle lies at the heart of this romantic drama with an eve of World War II setting. Starring Kwan Shan, Li Ting.

programme.title: Mr Funny Bone
programme.desc: Whenever Mr. Funny Bone travels about with his sidekick Big Potato, he often gets involved in all manner of charming comic mishaps.

programme.title: The Tigress of Shaolin
programme.desc: Hui Ying-hung co-stars with Liu Chia-yung in this fast-paced comedy that features the outrageous Leprosy Boxing style.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: From veteran director Li Han-hsiang comes this fascinating period drama, starring Li Kun as the ingenious Lord Liu, who is much envied by the Emperor.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: A village boy recruits his friends to help peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: A poor young woman becomes a popular bargirl in Hong Kong's gritty response to Hollywood's The World of Suzie Wong.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: A Shaolin hero and the vicious Pai Mei lock horns in this kungfu revenge tale that spans two generations.

programme.title: Forever and Ever
programme.desc: Huangmei Opera queen, Ivy Ling Po stars in this tale of a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter a girl who is dying.

programme.title: Heroes of Sung
programme.desc: In this period action film, Meng Hung (Shih Szu) must work with Fan Tien-Fu (Lo Lieh) to protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: This moving tale centers on a childless woman who cares for an emotionally battered girl.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang brings us this delightful adventure, which revolves around Emperor Chien Lung's incognito journey through China.

programme.title: Twin Blades of Doom
programme.desc: A man who left the martial world returns to action and goes on the road to vengeance after the evil Ghost Gang kills his parents.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Kung fu idols Wang Yu, Lo Meng and Loh Lieh star in this comedy set in a Shaolin temple where Hung Hsi-kuan and Fang Shih-yu become disciples.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Ling Yun of 'Hellgate' plays a magician-warrior who unwittingly protects a villain from an ambush, until his wife and friend's deaths open his eyes.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: See how Prince 4 tries his hardest to kill the heir apparent, Prince 14 and how, out of frustration, he finally engages an assassin to do the job.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: In this film, award winning actor Ku Feng stars as the 'Whip Devil' alongside Shih Szu as the 'The Lady Hermit' against the masters of mayhem.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: This splendid, award-winning film features Li Li Hua as the Empress Wu Tse-tien, the most powerful woman in China's four thousand year history.

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei, swordswoman extraordinaire, teams with Lo Lieh in this fast-paced 'Martial Arts World' adventure, a quest for the legendary 'Jade Dragon Sword.'

programme.title: Let's Fall in Love
programme.desc: Pressured by his parents to marry prior to taking over his father's business, Guan rejects every girl they find but then, he stumbles upon the perfect one?

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: After a kung-fu master (Lau Kar Leung) is crippled by a ruthless villain, he teaches a boy monkey kung-fu to avenge his shame.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Pat Ting Hung, Carrie Ku Mei and Li Hsiang Chun star in this delightful tale of mistaken identities caused by monogrammed handkerchiefs.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: This is a thrilling mix of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, vengeance and edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Moods of Love
programme.desc: How far would you go for love? Or lust? These are the questions posed in two, sinfully entertaining Sung Dynasty tales that comprise this film.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: A murdered emperor's two sons are raised apart but their paths eventually cross, and so do theirs with the imperial throne's usurper.

programme.title: Na Cha and the Seven Devils

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: When a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom, a persecuted waiter turns to a famed 'drunken master' for help.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: After enduring several trials (including his girlfriend's rape), a man (Chen Wo-Fu) puts his tai chi skills to deadly use.

programme.title: Love Without End

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: The protector (Ti Lung) of the Pai clan's coveted secret martial arts manuscript also has to protect a Pai female who's under threat.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment

programme.title: Gambler's Delight

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: This classic romance stars Linda Lin and Kwan Shan| capturing a touching love story between a famous nightclub singer and a young architect.
